edges.reason: transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom
transferFrom compares msg.sender to _from and consumes allowance[_from][msg.sender]
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before the delegatecall
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded address before minting
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply
transfer unconditionally delegates execution to transferFrom
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) to return true
ensure falls through to condition when the sender is not whitelisted
transferFrom executes unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value
transferFrom executes unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value
transferFrom executes unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value
batchSend executes unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value inside its loop
_mints writes an arbitrary balanceOf[spender] and grants canSale access
init rewrites the sale limits that gate every transfer through condition
delegate passes user-supplied target and calldata into a delegatecall
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance for the spender
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with a caller-chosen value
ensure grants an unconditional pass when canSale[_from] is true
ensure grants an unconditional pass when _from equals tradeAddress
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to cap sales per address
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer size
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer size

normalization_plan.reason: Destination address argument of transfer is only consumed by the transferFrom core function
Source address argument is consumed by the transferFrom core function and its ensure check
Amount argument flows directly into the transferFrom core function balances
Spender argument is only written into allowance by the approve core function
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum by the init core function
token parameter is assigned to _minSale by the init core function
maxToken parameter is assigned to _maxSale by the init core function
Recipient array is iterated only inside the batchSend core function
addr parameter is stored in tradeAddress by the setTradeAddress core function
Delegatecall target parameter is only used inside the delegate core function
Delegatecall calldata parameter is only used inside the delegate core function
spender parameter is written into balanceOf and canSale by the _mints core function
addedValue parameter is minted into balanceOf by the _mints core function
_UNI local is the cached pair address computed solely inside ensure
total local is the batch total computed solely inside batchSend
i local is the loop counter of the batchSend core function
_to local is the per-iteration recipient inside the batchSend core function
token0 local is the ordered token used only inside the pairFor core function
token1 local is the ordered token used only inside the pairFor core function
pair local is the derived address returned only by the pairFor core function
